name: web-industrial-mobile-site-phone-on-steel-frame
title: Industrial Mobile Site on Steel Frame
whatItIs: A high-resolution shot of a phone lying on a steel-framed surface showing a Cyrillic mobile landing page for metal grapples, with a hero photo and a royal-blue card with an outlined button.
whatItMeans: Reflective metal, hard shadows and a single blue block create a precise, engineered mood.
techniques: Phone set on reflective metal with hard shadows
Stacked bold headline followed by muted body text
Blue card overlapping the hero photo corner
Cool gradient backdrop lightening toward the top

vocabulary.definition: A rounded photo as the main visual of a mobile hero.
A crisp-edged shadow suggesting strong directional light.
A button with only a border, used as a secondary action.
